data.title: Speeding fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid), €98.50
data.summary: The district fine office (Bußgeldstelle Kreis Musterland) issued a fine notice on 15 September 2026 for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 25 August 2026. The total is €98.50, including a €70.00 fine, and 1 point is entered in the driving aptitude register.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding by 23 km/h outside built-up areas. The letter was formally delivered on 19 September 2026. You may file an objection (Einspruch), in writing or on record at the fine office. The app shows the deadline, which counts from delivery. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and enforceable, and you must pay €98.50 within two weeks of it becoming final, quoting the file number. The point in the register (Fahreignungsregister) is entered too. If you are unsure whether to object, consider legal advice.

items.title: File objection against fine notice

items.action: If you dispute the fine, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record with the fine office.
items.consequence: Without an objection the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and enforceable.

items.title: Pay fine of €98.50
items.action: Pay the total amount, quoting the file number, within two weeks after the notice becomes final (if you don't object).
items.consequence: The notice becomes enforceable if unpaid.
